description: Buddy Phase 27 — Feedback Loop Completion. Phase 26 added observability to decision points. Phase 27 closes feedback loops: activates observation consumer, health registry, execution efficiency tracking, P/L attribution, fast-track A/B logging, and override detection. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Enable observation consumer as active feedback loop
userStories.description: ObservationConsumer is built with 5 auto-adjustment patterns but defaults to False. Enable and wire into continuous loop.
userStories.notes: Changed default to True. Added step 3d in continuous.py — consumes observations, detects patterns, recommends adjustments, and logs alerts every 10 cycles.

userStories.title: Activate health registry for composite system health scoring
userStories.description: HealthRegistry module is built but disabled. Enable and wire into orchestrator status report.
userStories.notes: Changed default to True. Added health_registry block to orchestrator get_system_status() with system score and per-module scores. Logs health_degradation observation when score < 0.70.

userStories.title: Per-pair execution efficiency tracking with slippage trending
userStories.description: Slippage is tracked per pair but not trended or alerted.
acceptanceCriteria: Log high_slippage observation when reduction triggers
Include metadata: pair, avg_slippage, threshold, sample_count, reduction
userStories.notes: Added observation logging in execution.py when US-148 slippage reduction triggers. Logs to category='high_slippage' with full metadata including pair, avg slippage, threshold, sample count.

userStories.title: Fast-track execution A/B logging for threshold feedback
userStories.description: Fast-track executions bypass soft gate failures but lack outcome tracking.
acceptanceCriteria: Tag fast-track trades in analysis context
Track fasttrack_wins and total in execution manager
userStories.notes: Added result.fasttrack=True flag in engine.py fast-track path. Included in analysis_context for journal. Added _fasttrack_stats A/B tracker in sync_closed_trades_rl() — logs win rate every 5 fast-track trades.

userStories.title: Enable pair_regime_agent_matrix for cross-pair P/L attribution
userStories.description: pair_regime_agent_matrix.py tracks 3-way interactions but is disabled.
acceptanceCriteria: Feed outcomes to matrix from sync_closed_trades_rl()
Matrix tracks per-agent win rate by pair×regime
userStories.notes: Changed default to True. Added US-167 block in sync_closed_trades_rl() feeding agent verdicts with outcomes to _pram.record_vote(). Saves state after recording.

userStories.title: Wire manual trade override detection to orchestrator
userStories.description: orchestrator.py line 677 has TODO for manual trade detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect manual trades by comparing OANDA trades vs journal entries
Pass to aura bridge when available
userStories.notes: Added override detection before OutcomeSignal creation. Compares open OANDA trade IDs against journal. Unmatched trades = manual overrides. Logs to observation_log and passes to bridge via override_events parameter.
